== Two different lists for the same day and side ==
This list and [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Olaf Schroeder DS Spice Mine Operations]] are both filed as this player's Day 1 Dark deck at the [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]]. The card lists differ, so they are not duplicates. I couldn't find a source that says which list was played in which round, or whether players could change decks between rounds at this event. The available coverage gives no deck-to-round mapping. Please update the Stage field and the player page if you have a source.
